item.description: Gramophone Dreams #105: The Hot Club of New York and the Kitsuné KTE LCR-1 MK5 phono stage John Atkinson Thu, 02/05/2026 - 05:59 Show Promo Image Last night, I sat on a bright yellow velveteen sofa eating red beans and rice while listening for three hours to blues and jazz from rare 78rpm records. item.title: Doshi Audio Evolution Stereo power amplifier
item.description: Doshi Audio Evolution Stereo power amplifier John Atkinson Fri, 02/06/2026 - 06:16 Show Promo Image Nick Doshi is cautiously reserved when he talks about his amplifiers, preferring to let the products speak for themselves. At every show I've heard them at, from Chicago to DC to Munich, they have done exactly that: Every system I've heard featuring a Doshi amp has delivered great sound. When I pressed him as to why, he just smiled. Ken Micallef 0 0 Doshi Audio Charlottesville VA 22901 info@doshia
